title: Park Hyatt Zanzibar
description: Wake up inside a UNESCO World Heritage Site, where Stone Town's historic streets meet sweeping Indian Ocean views. Two pools and celebrated dining make this one of Tanzania's most refined island stays.

title: Emerson Spice Hotel
description: A centuries-old merchant's house turned romantic hideaway, with 11 individually designed rooms and a legendary rooftop Tea House. Featured among Condé Nast Traveler's most distinctive stays.

title: Essque Zalu Zanzibar
description: Bold and distinctive resort featuring the highest makuti thatched roof on the island, with two restaurants, three bars and a lagoon-style pool just steps from the beach.

title: The Z Hotel Zanzibar
description: Tanzania's first designer hotel, featuring furniture by Philippe Starck just steps from Nungwi Beach — rated among the world's 25 most beautiful beaches.

title: Nungwi Dreams by Mantis
description: Beachfront boutique resort on Zanzibar's highest-rated beach, blending contemporary architecture with Swahili and Arabic design touches.

title: Canary Nungwi Hotel & Spa
description: Beachfront resort with spacious king-size rooms and private balconies, paired with a world-class spa and easy access to Nungwi's best dive sites.

title: Jafferji House
description: An exquisitely restored heritage property tucked into Stone Town's winding lanes, blending old Zanzibar architecture with elegant modern comfort.

title: Sharazād Wonders Boutique
description: Recognised as the most sustainable luxury boutique hotel in East Africa, featured among Condé Nast Traveler's best hotels for its design and cuisine.

title: Zanzibar Serena Hotel
description: A beautifully restored 19th-century merchant's house on the Stone Town seafront, combining authentic Swahili architecture with ocean views.

title: Baraza Resort & Spa
description: All-inclusive luxury on Zanzibar's serene south-east coast, with Arabian-themed architecture, private plunge pools and the award-winning Frangipani Spa.

title: Breezes Beach Club & Spa
description: A classic east-coast resort with beachfront bungalows, a PADI dive centre and four restaurants — a well-loved base for divers, snorkellers and families alike.

title: Kilindi Zanzibar
description: One of Zanzibar's most exclusive resorts — just 15 open-plan pavilions with private pools, adults-only and all-inclusive on a pristine north-western beach.
